acronymble.evidence: Original Acronymble publisher-site rules, retrieved unchanged from actual 2006 public Wayback captures linked by its archived navigation; same named Steven May/Acronymwits game, matching distinctive Nymwit/noodle terms, Length/Composition decks, example letters, board and victory. Main TheRules.htm and ALL six linked detailed rules sections were successfully retrieved and fully read: parts/preparation, cards, board, timer, important notes and helpful hints. Primary coverage includes 48 tiles with blanks, deck setup, starting Nymwit, four Composition card types, 3-7-word lengths, ordered-letter and word construction, anonymous Nymwit reading, Nymwit writes but does not vote, no self-votes, one sentence point plus votes, optional nonsense-card bonus even without votes, special board spaces, round rotation, finish without exact count, X-sound/blank exceptions and optional timer/extra five seconds for Word rounds. This is an original publisher/author HTML rules set, not an original printed-box PDF or a third-party reconstruction. All seven unchanged HTML packets are retained with individual URLs and SHA-256 hashes; canonical text separates each packet and normalizes only whitespace/line wrapping. Inline decorative letter styling can introduce spaces inside example words; the unchanged HTML governs exact typography. Printed board, complete card-face deck and timer/physical components are not reconstructed or certified; these rules describe their use. The publisher expressly suggests optional board-space simplifications and a final -2 to +2 variant; both remain labelled suggestions, not silently adopted mandatory rules. The modern .com redirects to a domain-sale page and the .co link to unrelated gambling content; neither is rules. A first broad archive query timed out, but a bounded pre-2016 HTML index and actual linked captures succeeded. Secondary Italian guide and older/current encyclopedia descriptions were discovery/comparison leads only; none is substituted into this primary canonical text. One specific MAJOR scoring/anonymous-reading finding is recorded; no complete summary audit, PASS or summary-body repair.
